**Why I stopped:** Dana's reservation history is empty, so there's no record of a usual hotel. I didn't want to guess and charge the corporate card for the wrong place.

| ID | Hotel | Per night | Total for 2 nights | Trip total with F100 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | Midtown Lodge | $189 | $378 | $667 |
| H2 | Harbor Inn | $239 | $478 | $767 |
| H3 | Plaza Grand | $459 | $918 | $1,207 (over $1,000, so it needs manager approval) |

**What I need from you:** Tell me which hotel Dana usually stays at. I'll then book it and F100 together in one booking and confirm the details. Only 4 seats are left on F100, so it's best to decide soon.

trace.message: Dana always stays at the Harbor Inn (hotel H2).
